title: Repair

sub.one: {n} active project: {open} open, {fix} repairable by the app, {lost} with lost settings, {missing} with something missing.
sub.other: {n} active projects: {open} open, {fix} repairable by the app, {lost} with lost settings, {missing} with something missing.

rescanTitle: Rereads every project and the list of plugins installed in Live (after installing a plugin)
rescanned: Everything reread, including Live's plugin list.
completeIfOrder: Complete projects if you install in the suggested order

tabs.atelierTitle: Treatments: colours, names, track order, cleanup, markers, template
tabs.copiesTitle: Every copy Spool has written next to your projects

fix.intro: Each repair writes a copy "Name [R].als" next to the project. The original is never modified.

completeCount.one: {n} copy will open with nothing missing.
completeCount.other: {n} copies will open with nothing missing.

fix.onlyComplete: Only those that will be complete
fix.withPresetTitle: The same copy also gets the preset's treatments (colours, names, order...), its name carries their letters
fix.emptyText: No active project has a renamed plugin, a found sample or a plugin to remove.

install.orderIntro: In this order, each plugin completes the most projects (projects of songs further along count more). Today: {now} complete projects out of {total}.

vst3All.one: plugin missing as VST2 has its VST3 installed, which takes over the VST2's settings ({names}).
vst3All.other: plugins missing as VST2 have their VST3 installed, which takes over the VST2's settings ({names}).

install.vst3Automated: Projects where they are automated ({n}) keep the VST2: the automation would not carry over.

vst3Switched.one: {n} plugin replaced by its VST3 in repaired copies: its projects are now "repairable by the app".
vst3Switched.other: {n} plugins replaced by their VST3 in repaired copies: their projects are now "repairable by the app".

install.trialSet: "{name}" will be replaced by "{to}" in repaired copies
install.ignoreTitle: Stop counting it, remove it from repaired copies
install.ignoreKeepTitle: Stop counting it, but leave it in the copies so you can replace it by hand

status.other_vst2: another VST2 of the same plugin

ignored.intro: Plugins you no longer use: they no longer count as missing. A repaired copy removes them, except the "kept" ones (to replace by hand in Live).

samples.moved: found elsewhere (a repaired copy brings them back)
samples.deepLast: Last search on the old drive: {root}, {files} files read.
samples.deepLastOn: Last search on the old drive: {root}, {files} files read, on {date}.
samples.deepNone: No search on the old drive yet.
samples.oldDriveFirst: First set the old Windows in {link}.
samples.deepStarted: Search on the old drive started: progress shows at the bottom left.
samples.colFrom: Where the missing samples came from

sheet.series: : any {major}.x version from {v} on, ideally the latest of the series

todo.trialAu: Project from a Mac: the repaired copy replaces this AU version with {trial}, the Windows version of the same plugin, in the same place, with its settings converted. The original project is not modified.
todo.trial: The project's version can't be found: the repaired copy replaces it with {trial}, in the same place, with the same settings. The original project is not modified.
todo.vst3Safe: The VST2 is missing, {name} (VST3) is installed: the repaired copy uses it in the same place. Its vendor supports loading the VST2's settings. The original project is not modified.
todo.vst3Listen: The VST2 is missing, {name} (VST3) is installed: the repaired copy uses it in the same place. Listen to check: not every vendor carries over the VST2's settings. The original project is not modified.
todo.renamed: Already here as "{name}". The repaired copy keeps the settings.
todo.portableWhy: The portable version came from {path}. Same version installed = same settings; the repair will link them if the name differs.
todo.newerWhy: There is only {have} here, which Live won't use in its place (a different identifier): install the project's version too, both can live side by side.
todo.toVst3Try: Only the VST3 is installed. Run the installer again and tick VST2, or use the VST3 below in projects where nothing is automated.
todo.toVst3: Only the VST3 is installed, and it doesn't declare that it takes over the VST2's settings: run the installer again and tick VST2 to get the exact sound back.
todo.auWhy: Project from a Mac: reinstall the VST equivalent on Windows.
todo.bothFormats: The old PC also had the VST3: tick both.
todo.elsewhere: Not on the old PC either: comes from another machine.

sheet.keepToReplace: Keep it to replace by hand
sheet.removeTitle: The repaired copy no longer contains this plugin or its automation
sheet.keepTitle: The plugin stays in the copy, in its place, so you can replace it with an equivalent
sheet.anyUpdate: . Within one product, Live loads any update: get the latest.
sheet.trialAu: Project from a Mac: Windows has no AU. In repaired copies, {name} is replaced in the same place by the Windows version (VST2) of the same plugin, with its settings converted. This plugin's automation is not carried over.
sheet.trialText: In repaired copies, {name} is replaced in the same place by the installed version, with the same saved settings.
sheet.trialNote: The original project is never modified. The sound may differ: listen before you commit.
sheet.vst3Text: The project expects the VST2 version, but the VST3 is installed and declares that it replaces it: in repaired copies, every {name} becomes the VST3, in the same place, with its settings and preset. The original project is never modified.

vst3Automated.one: Automated in {n} project: the VST3 doesn't carry over the automation, so this project needs the VST2. Install it to get the project back exactly.
vst3Automated.other: Automated in {n} projects: the VST3 doesn't carry over the automation, so these projects need the VST2. Install it to get them back exactly.

sheet.vst3Safe: Safe: this VST3 declares that it replaces this VST2 and reads its settings.
sheet.vst3Unset: No longer replaced by the VST3
sheet.vst3Set: {name} will be replaced by {to} (VST3) in repaired copies
sheet.presetsText: Read from the state the plugin saved: it's the starting preset, it may have been tweaked afterwards. With another version, reload it to get the base sound back.

copies.intro: The copies Spool has written next to your projects ({files}, {size}). Nothing is deleted from here: open the folder to tidy up yourself. A copy you have since saved in Live is yours: repairing it again makes another one, it is never overwritten.

devices.droppedMixTitle: Mix tool: left out, the new project starts from a neutral mix
devices.droppedOffTitle: Off in the project: left out
